functions.name: SteeringAngleController
functions.summary: AI steering-angle and driver-status controller called per-frame from AIMainUpdate. Otherwise it computes the error from a direction vector (this+0x34F8/0x3500) against the heading, updates a steering-error accumulator this+0x446C (decrement toward 0 when on-aim or slow, +5 when off-aim), and when the accumulator exceeds this+0x4558 it resets AI state, calls RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate when gear (this+0x39FC) > 2, and sets driverStatus = 1. functions.name: AIRacingLine
functions.summary: Per-frame AI racing-line and speed-profile update: resolves the nearest waypoint node and a look-ahead chain, computes aerodynamic drag from the lead car's closing distance, builds a speed profile across the waypoint chain using a tire-force energy-decay model, determines overtaking threat via pass scores, and produces throttle/brake targets (with a thermal brake ramp) plus an overtaking-window flag. On loss of the racing line it resets waypoint state and delegates to sub_426430.

v2 = SpatialTreeNearestNeighborSearch(dword_5EA2C0, vehicle position, CurrentWaypointPtr(0x4354), WaypointSetSelector(0x4550), 0): nearest waypoint node for the whole chain navigation.
Resolve the forward waypoint link: while the stored node id (0x454C) is valid but mismatches the primary link's id, fall back to the alternate link of the search node.
Resolve the look-ahead waypoint v5 through the second link level the same way; v5 drives overtaking and pass scoring below.
Drag-from-lead-car block: if the drag-active flag (0x443C) is set and the lead reference (0x4400) is valid, compute the closing-distance aero drag term.
F_3DTransformWithMatrixMultiplication(v53, v55): transform the current position into the lead-car frame.
v48 = distance to the lead car: sqrt((v54 - lead.z)^2 + (v53[0] - lead.x)^2) using the lead-car position at deref(0x4400) offsets 0x0/0x8.
AerodynamicForceCalc(Speed(0x4440), v48 * 0.4f, 0.75): compute the aero drag from the closing distance.
If v48 > 0: clear the drag-active flag (0x443C) and record the gap distance in 0x4524.
If the pass-window field (0x4424) is 0.0, re-test the pass window against the lead waypoint's forward link: window size from deref(0x4400)+0x18, linked node through deref(0x4400)+0x114.
Distance v45 to the linked waypoint (link offsets 0x94/0x9C); build a clamped pass threshold from the waypoint size. When inside the window, clear 0x443C and set 0x4424 to half or full waypoint size.

Gap-maintenance block: if the stored gap (0x4524) is non-zero, re-run the pass-window test with a wider 1.2x threshold against the lead waypoint; when the car is inside, clear the overtake flags (0x4468, 0x443C) and update the pass window (0x4424) to half or full waypoint size.
F_3DTransformWithMatrixMultiplication(v53, v55): transform the current position into the lead-car frame again for the gap test.

When the pass-window re-test applies, a wider 1.2x distance threshold against the linked waypoint decides whether the car is still inside the overtaking window; clear the overtake flag 0x4468 and the drag flag 0x443C and set the pass window 0x4424 accordingly.

v23 = distance from the vehicle to the current waypoint (deref(0x4400) offsets 0x0/0x8); v24 = pass-direction dot product with the forward-link tangent (offsets 0xC/0x14), or a fallback comparison when no link is present.
If the pass-direction dot product v24 is not positive, or the waypoint gap v23 is not greater than the stored gap (0x4524), branch to the racing-line reset path.

Reset path: zero the waypoint counters 0x34F8/0x34FC/0x3500, the target waypoint 0x43F8, the gap 0x4524, the brake target 0x4434 and the pass window 0x4424; clear the drag flag 0x443C and the byte 0x45F4; set throttle 0x4438 to 1.0f; clear the node id 0x454C and set WaypointSetSelector 0x4550 to 1; set driverStatus (0x4510) to 4 or 5 by dword_7C56A4; call AIClearStateFlags then sub_426430(this) and return.

Mid-gap branch: if the waypoint gap v23 is greater than 0.5, store it in 0x4524 and call AerodynamicForceCalc(Speed(0x4440), v23*0.3f, 0.7f); then set throttle 0x4438 and brake 0x4434 (brake via BrakeThermalModel when the factor is non-positive, otherwise throttle 1.0f and brake 0) and return.
Else build the speed profile: v49 = Speed(0x4440) * 1.05; v26 = (AIComputePassScore(v2) < v49 || AIComputePassScore(alternate link) < v49): overtaking threat against this car's pace.

If the look-ahead node v5 differs from CurrentWaypointPtr (0x4354), walk the chain storing Speed(0x4440) into the speed-profile array at 0x43A4 (up to 20 entries).
Reset the target fields: 0x43F8 = 0 and 0x43FC = 9999.0f (default target speed).

functions.name: AIWaypointSteeringUpdate

Returns 1 when the update completed or was skipped early.

If CurrentWaypointPtr (0x4354) is null, resolve it with SpatialNearestNeighborQueryWithPlaneTest(dword_5EA2C0, position 0x34E0, WaypointSetSelector 0x4550); return 0 on failure.
If the current waypoint drifted more than 3200 units from position (0x34E0/0x34E8), re-query the nearest waypoint, store it in 0x4354 and set the chain-rebuild byte 0x4488.

If the chain-rebuild byte 0x4488 is set, rebuild the 20-node look-ahead waypoint chain.
